about_the_game:
Strap in, spread your wings, and ignite your jetpack—Jet Birds is a high-speed, high-skill racing game where precision flying is the key to victory. Take control of a jet-powered bird and weave through breathtaking natural environments, balancing speed and control.

Master the Skies

With full control over pitch, yaw, and roll, plus the ability to adjust your wingspan on the fly, every turn and dive is in your hands. Use your dodge and dash abilities to avoid obstacles and dart through gaps as you fine-tune your flight to shave milliseconds off your time.

Race Against the Clock

Challenge yourself in time trial races, pushing the limits of speed and precision to dominate the global leaderboards. Every second counts as you refine your route, optimize your aerodynamics, and perfect your jet-fueled maneuvers.

Choose Your Bird, Choose Your World

Soar through over 20 unique environments, from towering mountain peaks to dense jungle valleys, each offering a distinct challenge. Select from a diverse roster of jetpack-equipped birds, each with their own personality and flight characteristics.

Features:

✅ Precision Flight Mechanics – Full 3D movement with advanced controls for a true test of skill.

✅ High-Fidelity Physics – True-to-life aerodynamics where every adjustment affects your flight.
✅ Time Trial Racing – Compete against yourself and others to climb the leaderboards.
✅ Dynamic Environments – Over 20 beautifully crafted natural landscapes to race through.
✅ Customized Birds – Choose from a variety of birds, each with unique designs and flight characteristics.

Whether you're a speed-running pro or just looking for the thrill of high-velocity flight, Jet Birds will push your skills to the limit. The sky is yours—fly fast!

name: Jet Birds

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.9 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX650 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (x64)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.6 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: A time attack game where you race as jetpack-powered birds
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Swedish
